text: **THE CANON SET IS ENUMERABLE BY DERIVATION FROM THE TREE AND THE CANON, NEVER BY A HAND-WRITTEN LIST.** **THIS IS A CLAIM ABOUT THE SET, LIVE AND CHECKABLE AT ANY MOMENT, RATHER THAN A CLAIM ABOUT ANY REVIEW.** A hand-listed population goes stale the day a document or a skill is added -- and from that moment **every coverage claim resting on it is false while still reading true**, which is the failure this row exists to make impossible rather than to detect. Coverage then follows as a CONSEQUENCE: *all of them were examined* becomes a checkable statement about a derived population instead of an unfalsifiable one about somebody's diligence. **AND THE POPULATION IS THE FIRST THING A REVIEWER INHERITS, NOT THE LAST**: the next review of this set gets the enumeration and not this thread's catalogue, so the derivation is what outlives the work rather than the findings. **STATED AS ENUMERABILITY RATHER THAN AS COVERAGE ON vc's AMENDMENT 2026-09-02: a coverage claim is retrospective and unfalsifiable, and a criterion that could only ever be satisfied by a review that has already happened is not a bar.**
